items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...When the drum aid hit Don, you better be ready.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. That's what I say. Yeah. Here, you just play a parade. You be walking, say ta-ta-ta-ta. What's it gonna play, man? Cisticate anything, man. Just play. But not in the neighborhood.
Mm-mm. They call them marches, huh? Oh, man. When the drum aid hit Don, you better be ready. You better be ready.

You had to read. No faking there. You had to read there. You could have a parade. But you couldn't think in the dance bands in the services. No, no. You only had to read there too. You could have everybody in a military band in a dance band. Some fellas couldn't know. They were very, very good on the marches. Yeah. I mean, they could really play the marches.
